arguments.command:
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; D=.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py; \
$D pref 'screen_config_dot={"type":"dot","showSongInfo":true,"textScale":1.5}:string' > /dev/null; \
$D pref 'active_screen_id=dot:string' > /dev/null; \
$D screen dot > /dev/null; \
$D play /opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus > /dev/null; \
sleep 2; \
$D shoot dot_textscale_1_5 --pixel-ratio 1.0
